## Research focus

The article describes a web-based preparation environment for online competitive
examinations, initially focused on GATE. The framework separates administrator,
coordinator, and student roles and uses Java, Struts, Hibernate, MySQL, and Tomcat.
Its design includes a database schema and UML models of the application.

## Project context

The paper documents development and local testing at Uttkarsh Research Centre,
U.V. Patel College of Engineering, Ganpat University, and acknowledges guidance
from Prof. Rakesh D. Vanzara and Prof. Ketan J. Sarvakar. I am the sole listed author.

The proposed educational benefits should be distinguished from measured learning
outcomes; this record does not assert a controlled evaluation of student performance.
